name: engineer-testable-requirements
job: Turn requirements into testable acceptance criteria with oracles, traceability, and change authority.

inScope: Eliciting needs from primary evidence and labeling their type
Negotiating conflicts and recording rejected needs with rationale
Tracing requirements bidirectionally and baselining with change authority
outOfScope: Executable implementation specifications and work contracts

inputs: Stakeholder needs and current primary evidence
System boundary, lifecycle stage, and external authorities
outputs: Requirements Contract with requirement register and oracles
Scenario and state model with failure and recovery paths

data: primary evidence: research, incidents, contracts, policies, interfaces
permissions: access to protected evidence per audience allowlist

failureSemantics: Acceptance criteria without purpose, context, affected parties, failure behavior, or quality constraints are not complete; priority labels and generated prose are never validation; implementation choices never hide inside requirements.

outcome.observable: A Requirements Contract where each accepted requirement has an oracle and success boundary, traces to a source need and forward artifacts, and changes require impact analysis and supersession under a named authority.
